summary: Defines methods to retrieve service codes and details based on course and timetable IDs for session management in a system.
purpose: To handle operations related to service codes, including listing all available service codes and fetching them by course or timetable ID.

fields.name: CodeCategoryID
fields.description: Identifier for the category of the service code.

fields.name: ShortName
fields.description: Short name or identifier of the service code.

workflows.name: Service Code Retrieval
steps: Initiate session and set procedure name.
Add session and course/timetable ID as parameters.
Read data and populate ServiceCode objects.
Close data reader and return list of service codes.
